summary: Played the changed parts (free camera, follow camera, mini game levels, dance ring view) in the live dashboard and re-ran the five suite failures alone: the horizon, second-wave, sleeper-wave and parade-join tests pass alone (suite-order flakiness), the flower-field overview check fails whenever the camera was not already free before. Added one test (Berry race levels).

failures.what: Switching the camera to free mode from code resets any eye/target that was set with it: freecam's free_start! runs next frame and overrides it, so the overview-camera check misses the flower field.
failures.steps: game.rig.mode = :follow; wait; then run the test 'The golden flower field ... in view of the overview' (it sets rig.mode = :fixed with the progress overview eye/target). It passes when the rig is already :fixed.
failures.expected: A camera set to :fixed with its own eye and target keeps them (the progress overview, plugins, tests).
failures.actual: free_start! (plugins/freecam.jl, step!) moves the eye to Sprout's low view; check failed: the field is out of the overview. Fix: free_start! only when the eye was not changed in the same frame, or let callers say so.

failures.what: After a mini game the camera always returns to Follow, even when the player had chosen Orbit or Free.
failures.steps: Choose Camera: orbit (or free), pick Berry race, Play, Stop.
failures.expected: The camera the player picked comes back.
failures.actual: Mode and menu are Camera: follow after Stop (checked for follow, orbit, free).

failures.what: Berry race start card at level 2 shows 'Press W to start' twice and the card covers the middle of the view with the camera looking steeply down at the start line.
failures.steps: Win a Berry race round, press R.
failures.expected: One start prompt, the world visible around the card.
failures.actual: A prompt above the card and the same one inside it.

failures.what: Suite-order flakiness: 'Jump in: second wave follows', 'wave next to a sleeper' and 'Parade: curious critter joins' fail in the full run but pass alone; the sea horizon test failed in the suite (0.049 ripple) and passed alone. Leftover state from earlier tests is the likely cause.
failures.steps: Run the full suite, then each of these alone with live_tests(name).
failures.actual: Fail in the suite, pass alone.

tests_added: Berry race: a win steps up a level (start card, saved level), a loss does not; Stop and Play again twice works
